summary: [standards] The canon fixture has no `timeoutSeconds`, so the default 30 s applies to every invocation and to `init` in `setup`. On this shared, loaded machine a debug-build run of the checker on canon took 22 to 50 s wall, and one run ended with exit 2 FIXTURE_INVALID `the setup command init ran over the 30 second limit`; the next three runs passed. Not reproducible on demand and not a checker defect, but the CI job and `just atip` are exposed to it on a slow runner. Proposal: add `timeoutSeconds` (for example 120) to the generated fixture. Blast radius: the CI job `atip-l0` and `just atip`.
